exposure: Pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV) 3+0 schedule (doses at 2, 4, 6 months)
Vaccination status (vaccinated vs. unvaccinated with PCV7, PCV13)
cohort: A birth cohort of 1.4 million children born in Australia between 2001 and 2012, followed until <2 years old.
finding: A universal 3+0 PCV program with >90% coverage provided high population-level protection against IPD, demonstrating high vaccine effectiveness (e.g., 94.2% for PCV7 serotype-specific IPD) predominantly due to strong herd effects.
